_doc: Stream P-core (round 8, W9 Professions) — MADE by tools/content-professions.mjs; do not edit by hand (edit the tables in the tool and run it). materials: every stackable material (price = what a merchant pays for one). classes: the material of each tier 1-5 by what it is (metal, leather, cloth, wood, gem, herb, mushroom, fibre, ore, hide, resin). nodeKinds: what a node gives and how it looks (look.model boulder | tree | herb | mushroom | fibre). tools. recipes (kind material | tool | gear | potion | good; a gear recipe lists the real bases of C's catalog you may pick). goods: the consumables recipes make, as bag items. skins: which monsters a skinner can skin. trainers: NPCs this system places (world metres). jobs: job frames appended to the job board.

jobs.title: Mine 6 Copper Ore
jobs.text: The forge eats copper faster than I can swing. Six lumps of ore, any boulder with green in it.

jobs.title: Mine 4 Tin Ore
jobs.text: Copper without tin is a doorstop. Four of tin, the grey boulders.

jobs.title: Smelt 3 Bronze Bars
jobs.text: Use my fire. Three bronze bars on the rack and I will pay you for the sweat.

jobs.title: Mine 8 pieces of ore
jobs.text: Walk the road, hit what glints. Eight pieces of any ore and you have earned your supper.

jobs.title: Fell 6 logs
jobs.text: I mark the trees, you fell them. Six logs, from the trees with the painted band.

jobs.title: Skin 4 hides
jobs.text: Four hides, off anything with fur. Keep the knife moving and do not hack.

jobs.title: Gather 6 Meadowmint
jobs.text: Meadowmint, six sprigs. The blue-green patches in open grass. Not the nettles. Never the nettles.

jobs.title: Brew 2 Healing Potions
jobs.text: My hands shake before noon. Brew two healing potions on my still and the shelf and I are both grateful.

trainers.name: Bram Delver
trainers.title: Prospector
trainers.greeting: See the boulders with green in them, out past the gate? That is copper, and it is yours for the price of three good swings.
